title: Number-identity-specific lag-1 persistence beyond pooled overlap

source.source_kind: canonical main archive prefix through 2026-11-10; historical strict-prior reconstruction, not contemporaneous freezes

hypothesis: The identity of each number in the immediately preceding draw may carry heterogeneous recurrence/avoidance information beyond a single pooled overlap effect. A per-number lag-1 conditional fixed-size subset distribution may improve joint subset log-loss and marginal inclusion Brier over both the uniform 5-of-40 null and a pooled lag-1 model.

definitions.draw: D_t is a five-element subset of {1,...,40}.
definitions.transition: For each target t, use only transitions (D_{j-1},D_j) with j<t.
definitions.pooled_counts: N_plus=number of prior transitions whose previous draw contains a number (5 per transition); C_plus=sum of lag-1 overlaps. N_minus=35 per transition; C_minus=sum of current-draw numbers absent from the previous draw.
definitions.per_number_counts: For number i, n_i_plus and c_i_plus count prior transitions with i in the previous draw and in the current draw respectively; n_i_minus and c_i_minus count transitions with i absent from the previous draw and present in the current draw respectively.
definitions.subset_distribution: For positive weights w_i, P(S|D_{t-1})=product_{i in S}(w_i)/e_5(w_1,...,w_40), for every five-number subset S.

models.M0: Uniform 5-of-40 distribution; each five-subset has probability 1/658008 and each number has inclusion probability 0.125.
models.M1: Pooled lag-1 model. With fixed alpha=200 and p0=0.125: p_plus=(alpha*p0+C_plus)/(alpha+N_plus); p_minus=(alpha*p0+C_minus)/(alpha+N_minus); theta_pool=logit(p_plus)-logit(p_minus); w_i=exp(theta_pool*I(i in D_{t-1})).
models.M2: Identity-specific model. For each i: p_i_plus=(alpha*p_plus+c_i_plus)/(alpha+n_i_plus); p_i_minus=(alpha*p_minus+c_i_minus)/(alpha+n_i_minus); theta_i=logit(p_i_plus)-logit(p_i_minus); w_i=exp(theta_i*I(i in D_{t-1})). The per-number estimates shrink toward the pooled conditional rates.
models.tuning: No parameter grid, no tuning, no subgroup search. Alpha is fixed before computation.

design.update_order: Score each target using counts from strictly prior transitions, then update counts with the just-observed transition.
design.primary_metric: Joint five-subset log-loss under the normalized fixed-size subset distribution; lower is better.
design.secondary_metric: Mean marginal Bernoulli Brier score across 40 numbers; lower is better.

inference.gain_direction: Baseline loss minus model loss; positive favors the model.
inference.multiple_testing: Holm across the six preregistered Blind OOS endpoints only.

integrity.target_cutoff: Each target uses only draws strictly before it; all model scores are computed before updating with the target.

limitations: Q138 is part of a large exploratory research family. Holm correction covers only the six Q138 Blind OOS endpoints, not all prior Q00-Q137 experiments.
The historical Blind OOS has been exposed to earlier SONAR research and is not a virgin prospective holdout.
This is a historical strict-prior reconstruction, not a contemporaneous record of forecasts frozen before each target.
The 2026-11-11 draw is excluded because its primary number provenance remains unresolved in the canonical archive workflow.
The model tests number-identity-specific lag-1 recurrence in a fixed-size subset distribution; it does not establish that lottery draws are predictable or produce a guaranteed quintet.
next_action: Run the fixed protocol on the pinned 3,404-draw source prefix. If M2 does not improve over M1 on the historical Blind OOS after Holm correction, retain M0 and M1 as research controls only; do not promote.
